title: A review on technologies for the removal of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFASs) in aquatic environments
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00092K, Critical Review
Open Access

Hao Zang, Yingming Feng, Shengyuan Gao, Mangmang Su, Qiyan Feng, Xiangfeng Chen
This review summarizes PFAS removal technologies in aqueous systems and analyzes the efficacy, functional mechanisms, and structure–activity relationships governing each technique.
